public_body: Board Of Building Regulations And Standards
overall: The AG found the Building Official Certification Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law: the closed session was a quasi-judicial decision meeting outside the Law's scope, and extra assertions were declined.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the three closed-session notice topics citing G.L. c. 112, § 65C lacked sufficient specificity to inform the public of the anticipated discussion.
allegations.key_passage: Where the closed session at issue was held for the sole purpose of the Committee making a decision in an adjudicatory proceeding before it, we find that the closed session portion of the November 7 meeting was not subject to the requirements of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint additionally stated the complainant was not recognized by the Chair at the November 7 meeting and an individual did not receive sufficient notice.
allegations.key_passage: to the extent they are intended as additional allegations, we decline to review them because, even if true, they would not constitute violations of the Open Meeting Law.
